deferred_to_upstream.summary: Local-store novel commands (redemptions forecast/suggest, recognition gap/search-mine/values/audit) have no per-client-profile scoping
deferred_to_upstream.reason: internal/store/store.go's tables carry no account/profile column, so switching --client-profile mid-use can mix a previous account's rows into a local read. Fixing it needs a schema migration across the whole local-store layer, not a single-command change. Tracked at https://github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/issues/2015.
